crossRefs.note: “Therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘I said indeed that your house and the house of your father should walk…
David slept with his fathers, and was buried in David’s city.
“Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to…
In the seventh year, Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham…
Hezekiah did so throughout all Judah; and he did that which was good, right, and faithful before Yahweh his God.
Remember me, my God, concerning this, and don’t wipe out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and…
For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that…

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: They buried him in David’s city among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, and toward God and his house.
translations.bsb: And Jehoiada was buried with the kings in the City of David, because he had done what was good in Israel for God and His temple.
translations.kjv: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, both toward God, and toward his house.
translations.asv: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, and toward God and his house.
